name: freebase_life_periods_20_year_windows_v1
description: Freebase life-period graph windows with integer-year inclusive start/end fields, equivalent to half-open calendar intervals [start, end+1). The periods are years before 1500 (end 1499), 1500-1900 inclusive, then 20-year windows 1901-1920 through 2001-2020. The last period is deliberately finite: local valid birth/death observations end in 2015. Membership uses only observed valid life intervals or a known birth/death endpoint and does not extrapolate unknown life years or future observations.
